summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the Enterprise Grid / Pocket layer + universal-command bugfix + regression. 25/25 pytest cases pass (test_iter182_enterprise_pocket.py, run with -n 0). Frontend E2E (mobile 390px) verifies: login → MikiLab → BakoMix Sense FAB → 'Grid · 100 Bakeries' button opens EnterpriseGrid; overview cards, both seeded sites (Stoccarda Super Saiyan 93.5%, Monaco Aura Bianca 82%), leaderboard rank1 with crown (Michele), fleet advice for Hans, spatial map with draggable equipment chips (oven_main_01), drag triggers optimize toast ('Risparmio movimenti/energia stimato al 10.5%'), NO horizontal overflow at 390px. Regression clean: /api/lab/pulse mood=sereno, morning-briefing OK, shift-plan OK. Universal-command bilancia bug is fixed (returns device_added, priority over generic aggiungi).

ui_bugs.issue: Immediately after a drag-drop that shows a Sonner toast, clicking [data-testid=enterprise-close] once did not always dismiss the grid in the automated run (toast overlay may absorb the tap briefly). Manual retry works; not blocking.

action_items: Optional: raise z-index of enterprise-close above the Sonner toaster (or delay toast) so a rapid close-tap right after drop always registers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 10326 lines — well past the 700-line guideline; consider splitting Enterprise/Pocket into a router module.
_seed_sites is idempotent by count>0 but on empty collection it runs on EVERY optional_user endpoint call — fine for now but consider a one-time startup task.

LayoutMove currently validates target_x/target_y with ge=0, le=100 (percent range) but coordinates are meters and clamped only to room_dimensions_m in the client; add server-side clamp against site.spatial_layout.room_dimensions_m to prevent equipment being placed outside the room.
/api/enterprise/site-shift updates via $push without a max-workers cap; consider a sanity limit.
pocket/master-command 'ricetta' branch matches even when 'sposta' also present – ordering could be documented; current order (forno→sposta→ricetta→briefing) is fine but relies on early-return.
seed_data_creation: Only relied on existing _seed_sites (Stoccarda + Monaco). Test-created site 'TEST_Milano', worker 'TEST_Marco', recipe id 'test_iter182_recipe', bilancia devices, and address_book feature were all deleted in the final_cleanup fixture. Oven_main_01 coords reset to (10.2, 3.1) after both backend and frontend runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter182 validates Enterprise Grid + Pocket + universal-command bugfix on top of iter181. Seeded lab_sites (bakery_01_stuttgart, bakery_02_munich) are intentional demos — do NOT delete. If oven_main_01 is not at (10.2, 3.1), re-optimize before running spatial tests. Use `-n 0` (pytest.ini forces -n 2 loadscope which is flaky on shared demo docs).
